title: fake fox news graphic says trump ordered death penalty lindsay clancy 2026 09 10
text:
A fabricated Fox News graphic was shared online to claim that U.S. President Donald Trump has imposed ​the death penalty on Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts ‌mother whose trial for killing her three young children ended in a mistrial on September 4.
